I'm a sweaty, stinky chick especially after a long day or at least by the next morning..not anymore. reviews.t: it goes on like a glue stick
reviews.x: Whoa! If you can't or don't want to use deodorant with harsh chemicals (especially those with aluminium something), stop looking. Yes, it goes on like a glue stick. If you hold it to your underarm for a 30 seconds or so as instructed), your body heat will soften the stick and it will go on easier. That said, this stuff works better than anything I have found-ever. And I have been looking for 20 years. Not cheap, but it works.

reviews.t: The best deodorant out there for super sweaters
reviews.x: Seriously the best deodorant I've ever used, and trust me, I've tried more than I care to remember. Not only does this deodorant smell fresh and delicious, but it seriously keeps the stink away, unlike any deodorant ever has. The wetness still occurs for me, but it's nothing a mid-day re-application can't fix. I cannot recommend this more for super sweaters like myself!

reviews.t: Watch out for the scent...
reviews.x: This product, while it may work efficiently as a deoderant, fell short in its description of the scent. There is absolutely NO Lavender smell to it what so ever. It smells so strongly of peppermint that I will not even try it. However my sister loves the smell, so she's getting a just because gift!

reviews.t: Highly effective, great smell
reviews.x: This is a good all natural deodorant.  It has a really pleasant smell, and is extremely effective.  The only problem is that it doesn't exactly slide on like a stick deodorant because it is like a thick paste, you end up better off if you just smear some on, rub it in with your fingers, then wash your fingers.  I didn't take away a star for this, because overall it is more effective than the natural deodorants that glide on smoothly.  This is my go-to when I know I will have a long hot day outsi

reviews.t: Works Great!
reviews.x: I am extremely impressed with this deodorant. I made the switch to aluminum free deodorant about 2 years ago and have struggled to find a product that would actually keep me from smelling. For me, this works %100. It even makes it through my intensive 90 minute long Vinyasa classes! I was a little worried that the baking soda might irritate my skin, but I am glad to report my pits are happy! I'm definitely going to order this again.

reviews.t: I was super excited the first few days I used this
reviews.x: I was super excited the first few days I used this.  I had finally found a natural deodorant that works!  It kept me quite dry and no BO! However, after about a week, I started developing a bright red, painful rash.  I'm not sure if this is a sensitivity to baking soda (which I've heard can happen), or if I just don't react well with the other ingredients.  I'm sad that I have to return it :(

reviews.t: Couldn't live with the painful rash
reviews.x: This product caused a nasty rash for both me and my husband. We had swollen lumps under our arms. It was a very unpleasant experience. I would advise caution. According to several other reviews, we aren't the only ones who experience the unpleasant side effect. Other than that, it worked pretty well. Unfortunate because it had potential.

reviews.t: I definitely recommend this product
reviews.x: I don't normally bother to write reviews for deodorant, but this is really high quality stuff. It lasts ALL day. I have never had a natural deodorant that I didn't have to re-apply, so I am pleasantly surprised. I definitely recommend this product!

reviews.t: Best so far!

reviews.t: Love it!

claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively controls odor and keeps them smelling fresh all day, even outperforming conventional brands.
Several reviewers praise the pleasant scent, though one notes the lavender mint smelled strongly of peppermint with no lavender.
Some reviewers report skin irritation or allergic reactions, including rashes and redness.
A few reviewers note the stick is firm and requires warming or extra rubbing to apply.
Some reviewers say it does not fully control wetness, requiring reapplication.
